objectives.statement: Report statements with verbs such as sa, fortalte, and mente followed by at.
Report yes/no questions with om and wh-questions with the question word, using subordinate-clause word order.
Place the subject before the finite verb and sentence adverbs before the finite verb inside reported clauses.
Adjust pronouns and time or place words when the speaker and situation change.

notes: Must teach reported statements, wh-questions, and yes/no questions with at/om and normal subordinate-clause word order. Include pronoun changes and time/place deictic shifts where natural. Avoid implying mandatory English-style tense backshift in Bokmål.
